newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks close lower, HCIA tumbles.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks close lower, HCIA tumbles.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite was down but off its intraday lows at Tuesday's close, recovering from the beating taken by HCIA Inc after a profit warning.

HCIA shares slid a whopping 27-1/8 points to 32-7/8 to top the Nasdaq most active list after saying that weak revenues would drag its earnings for the third quarter significantly below analysts' expectations.

The Nasdaq Composite Index was down 5.43 points, or 0.44 percent, to 1221.50 at its unofficial close after having sunk as low as 1214.60. Declines led advancing issues by 2306 to 1819 on volume of about 549 million shares.

Other stocks dragging Nasdaq down today included Xilinx Inc, which fell 2-3/8 to 31-5/8, after it too reminded Wall Street of the power of preannouncements by saying it expected net income and revenue for its second quarter ended September 28 to be below those in the prior quarter.
U.S. Robotics Corp continued to accumulate losses, closing down 1-5/8 at 63 in active trading.
On the positive side, Advanced Fibre Communications Inc AFCI.O shares rocketed higher on their first day of trading, closing up 20-1/8 at 45-1/8 after its initial public offering.
